fmt fix pushed (2cd4130); all 6 CI checks green on macOS + Linux (Linux leg also validated TIOCGWINSZ portability).
PR #12 squash-merged to main; remote branch deleted. Requirement.md and this state file backfilled retroactively at user request after the merge.

/wrapup complete: LESSON-457 (executable name is a trust surface) + LESSON-458 (skipped pipeline becomes retroactive debt) logged via fallback drafting (adlc-read unavailable); ADR-007 added to context/architecture.md (and ADR-006's stale tetond reference corrected); no ASSUME record (rationale in wrapup log); no deploy (rename ships with the next release tag).
